metadata.title: Victorian Ethereal Portrait with Vertical Sidebar

retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus Victorian-style portrait of a winged figure paired with a multi-colored vertical sidebar containing contrasting script and serif typography.
triggerTerms: vertical sidebar layout with script text
sepia pictorialist portrait with color block edge
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is required
vibrant neon color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a grainy, sepia-toned photograph of a child with angel wings in a soft-focus, dark environment, bordered on the right by two vertical color strips (cream and dark navy) containing rotated text.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic, soft-focus central image and the rigid geometric sidebar
Tonal harmony between the sepia image and the cream sidebar strip
Vertical text orientation mirroring the height of the frame
coreInvariants: Right-aligned vertical sidebar divided into two distinct color blocks
Combination of fluid script and rigid serif typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The winged figure is centrally located, occupying approximately 70% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, cream-colored vertical strip on the right acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central figure, moves right to the cream sidebar, and then follows the vertical text downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows surround the figure, creating a vignette effect that pushes focus inward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sepia and dark brown tones within the photographic area.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream (off-white) used for the primary sidebar strip.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark navy or charcoal used for the outermost thin vertical strip.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout, relying on value contrast between the dark background and the light skin/wings.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of fluid, slanted cursive and wide-tracked, all-caps Roman serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Script text must be rotated 90 degrees clockwise
Serif text must be rotated 90 degrees clockwise with extreme letter spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Roman numerals or uppercase letters in the outer strip are elongated and spaced to fill the vertical height.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic handwriting and formal, spaced-out classical serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, slanted script style of the primary text.
Provides the wide-tracked, small-cap serif feel for the outer strip.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square, sepia-toned, soft-focus photograph in the style of 19th-century pictorialism featuring a child with angel wings sitting in a dark, moody environment. Leave the right 20% of the frame empty for a sidebar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two vertical strips on the right: a wide cream strip and a thin dark navy strip. In the cream strip, place dark brown script text rotated 90 degrees clockwise. In the navy strip, place cream-colored, wide-tracked serif text rotated 90 degrees clockwise.

verificationChecks: Is the image sepia-toned and soft-focus?
Are there two distinct vertical color strips on the right edge?
Is the text rotated 90 degrees clockwise?
Is the script text dark brown on a cream background?

avoid: Clean vector lines in the image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the script text is legible despite the rotation.
Ensure the wings have a textured, feathered appearance rather than flat shapes.
Verify the outer sidebar strip is significantly narrower than the inner one.
Confirm the overall mood is somber and ethereal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Victorian Pictorialism + Vertical Sidebar Layout + Script/Serif Typographic Contrast
